name: sales
description: Beverage sales with standardized fields, dates and monetary amounts.

columns.description: Date associated with the sales record.
Sales channel grouping used in sales reporting, such as FOOD SERVICE, SUPERS or CONVENIENCE RETAIL.
Type of sales outlet or establishment, such as SUPERMARKET, RESTAURANT or CONVENIENCE STORE.
Packaging category description, such as 500ML 6P or 20Z/600ML.
Standardized name of the beverage packaging presentation.
Calendar year associated with the sales date.
Calendar month associated with the sales date.
Reporting period identifier associated with the sales record.
Normalized sales channel identifier used to relate sales to channel classifications.

silver_required_fields.description: Checks that sale_date, sales_amount, brand_flavor_code, package_category_code, package_name, trade_channel_key are populated.

silver_channel_exists.description: Checks that each sale references an existing Silver channel.

validation_description: Approved product keys and attributes used to check incoming Silver sales.
